My name no dey for book, but I sabi this my land well well. Rice no fit grow fine for this North Central area without small fertilizer, so I go buy urea and NPK if the agro-dealer get am, even if the price high this year. I no get borehole or pump, so na the rain and the fadama water wey go help me — I go plant when the rain steady. My wife and my two older pikin go helpfully work with me, but for transplanting and harvest time, one man hand no fit do am alone, so I go call small hired hands to join.
